key_insight: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 separates requirement fulfillment from artifact quality to evaluate AI authoring across multiple visual media.
engineering_relevance: The benchmark helps engineers distinguish compliance with task specifications from the quality of artifacts produced by AI authoring workflows.
method: Define 211 creation and modification tasks spanning presentations, static graphics, animations and videos, and web interfaces.
Score Task Fulfillment separately from Artifact Performance across Content, Organization, Visuals, and Delivery.
Use task-specific rating anchors grounded in source materials and artifact inspection records.
evidence_signal: Across nine model-harness configurations evaluated on all 211 tasks, overall scores ranged from 42.12 to 70.52, with Artifact Performance accounting for 73.4% of the highest-to-lowest score gap.
watch_item: Results characterize model-harness configurations, so score differences should not be attributed to models alone.
paper_title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
